headline: New shared duplicate-check and delivery guide for agentic upgrades
summary: Adds shared.mdx holding the duplicate-PR preflight and commit/deliver checklist, split out of the deleted agentic-upgrade.mdx and extended for Future Defaults commits. It is bundled and handed to the upgrade agent as instructions, so it shapes agent behavior but runs no code itself.
risk_signals: agent instruction text consumed by upgrade prompt
reason: Draft-marked agent instruction doc, mostly moved text; no executable code, but a short summary suffices for the reviewer.
